links.targetTitle: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)

title: The pitch positions Powerhouse as an addition to an existing offering, never a replacement
content:
The session recorded the ask verbatim: *"You already offer <software X> to your clients. Consider including Powerhouse to your offering as we integrate with <software X> for <missing functionality>."*

Three properties are worth naming. It asks the consultancy to expand an existing offering rather than change tools, so it competes with nothing they have already sold. It names the gap in someone else's product, which is a claim they can verify themselves. And it puts Powerhouse in the position of completing their proposition rather than complicating it.

The named functionality slots are IDP, structured data and business intelligence, document models, APIs, workflow automation, an app development platform, and a customized Vetra with pre-integrated industry and company data sources.
description: The scripted ask is 'You already offer software X to your clients. Consider including Powerhouse as we integrate with X for the missing functionality.'
